name: halt_then_resume
why: The halt/resume round-trip -- the surface that was reachable only on a box,
and where approve-never-executes hid: dispatch() never materialized the
tools on the resume path and chat_resume never applied the allowlist, so an
approved action came back 'unknown tool' and silently did nothing.
What this can prove OFFLINE is the round-trip itself: the turn halts with a
resumable handle, chat_resume accepts that handle, and the connector answers
coherently instead of crashing or losing the session. The WRITE it would
perform on accept needs an appliance, so a clean, named error there is the
expected offline outcome -- 'unknown tool' or a traceback is not.

steps.user: This playbook never creates the record. Diagnose it and offer me the fix.
